Task
  Represents a background task scheduled for execution.

  Variants:
    IndexDocument: Index document
      Fields:
        accountId     id<Account>  immutable
            Identifier of the account associated with this task
        documentId    string<string>  immutable
            Identifier of the document associated with this task
        documentType  enum (see IndexDocumentType)  immutable
            Type of document associated with the task
        due           datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        status        object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
    UnindexDocument: Unindex document
      Fields:
        accountId     id<Account>  immutable
            Identifier of the account associated with this task
        documentId    string<string>  immutable
            Identifier of the document associated with this task
        documentType  enum (see IndexDocumentType)  immutable
            Type of document associated with the task
        due           datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        status        object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
    IndexTrace: Index telemetry trace
      Fields:
        due      datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        status   object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
        traceId  id<Trace>  immutable
            Identifier of the trace associated with this task
    CalendarAlarmEmail: Calendar alarm e-mail
      Fields:
        accountId     id<Account>  immutable
            Identifier of the account associated with this task
        alarmId       number<unsignedInteger>  server-set
            Identifier of the calendar alarm associated with this task
        documentId    string<string>  immutable
            Identifier of the document associated with this task
        due           datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        eventEnd      datetime  server-set
            End date and time of the calendar event
        eventEndTz    number<unsignedInteger>  server-set
            Timezone identifier for the end date and time
        eventId       number<unsignedInteger>  server-set
            Identifier of the calendar event associated with this task
        eventStart    datetime  server-set
            Start date and time of the calendar event
        eventStartTz  number<unsignedInteger>  server-set
            Timezone identifier for the start date and time
        status        object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
    CalendarAlarmNotification: Calendar alarm notification
      Fields:
        accountId     id<Account>  immutable
            Identifier of the account associated with this task
        alarmId       number<unsignedInteger>  server-set
            Identifier of the calendar alarm associated with this task
        documentId    string<string>  immutable
            Identifier of the document associated with this task
        due           datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        eventId       number<unsignedInteger>  server-set
            Identifier of the calendar event associated with this task
        recurrenceId  number<integer>?  server-set
            Recurrence identifier for the alarm, if applicable
        status        object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
    CalendarItipMessage: Calendar iTIP message
      Fields:
        accountId   id<Account>  immutable
            Identifier of the account associated with this task
        documentId  string<string>  immutable
            Identifier of the document associated with this task
        due         datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        messages    list<TaskCalendarItipContents>  server-set
            List of iTIP messages associated with this task
        status      object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
    MergeThreads: Merge email threads
      Fields:
        accountId   id<Account>  server-set
            Identifier of the account associated with this task
        due         datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        messageIds  set<string<string>>  server-set
            Message-IDs of the email messages to be merged into the thread
        status      object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
        threadName  string<string>  server-set
            Name of the thread to be merged
    DmarcReport: Send DMARC report to remote server
      Fields:
        due       datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        reportId  id<DmarcInternalReport>  server-set
            Identifier for the DMARC aggregate report associated with this task
        status    object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
    TlsReport: Send TLS report to remote server
      Fields:
        due       datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        reportId  id<TlsInternalReport>  server-set
            Identifier for the TLS aggregate report associated with this task
        status    object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
    RestoreArchivedItem: Restore archived item
      Fields:
        accountId         id<Account>  server-set
            Identifier of the account to which the archived item belongs
        archivedItemType  enum (see ArchivedItemType)  server-set
            Type of the archived item associated with the blob
        archivedUntil     datetime  server-set
            Timestamp until which the archived item will be deleted permanently if not restored
        blobId            blob  server-set
            Identifier of the archived blob to be restored
        createdAt         datetime  server-set
            Timestamp when the item was originally created
        due               datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        status            object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
    DestroyAccount: Destroy account and all associated data
      Fields:
        accountDomainId  id<Domain>  mutable
            Domain identifier of the account to be destroyed, if applicable
        accountId        id<Account>  server-set
            Identifier of the account to be destroyed
        accountName      string<string>  mutable
            Name of the account to be destroyed
        accountType      enum (see AccountType)  server-set
            Type of the deleted account (user or group)
        due              datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        status           object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
    AccountMaintenance: Perform account maintenance operations
      Fields:
        accountId        id<Account>  immutable
            Identifier of the account to be maintained
        due              datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        maintenanceType  enum (see TaskAccountMaintenanceType)  immutable
            Type of maintenance operation to perform on the account
        status           object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
    TenantMaintenance: Perform tenant maintenance operations
      Fields:
        due              datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        maintenanceType  enum (see TaskTenantMaintenanceType)  immutable
            Type of maintenance operation to perform on the tenant
        status           object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
        tenantId         id<Tenant>  immutable
            Identifier of the tenant to be maintained
    StoreMaintenance: Perform store maintenance operations
      Fields:
        due              datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        maintenanceType  enum (see TaskStoreMaintenanceType)  immutable
            Type of maintenance operation to perform on the store
        shardIndex       number<unsignedInteger>?  mutable
            Index of the shard to perform maintenance on, if applicable for the maintenance type
        status           object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
    SpamFilterMaintenance: Perform spam filter maintenance operations
      Fields:
        due              datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        maintenanceType  enum (see TaskSpamFilterMaintenanceType)  immutable
            Type of maintenance operation to perform on the spam filter
        status           object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
    AcmeRenewal: Perform ACME certificate renewal for a domain
      Fields:
        domainId  id<Domain>  immutable
            Identifier of the domain associated with this task
        due       datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        status    object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
    DkimManagement: Perform DKIM key rotation for a domain
      Fields:
        domainId  id<Domain>  immutable
            Identifier of the domain associated with this task
        due       datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        status    object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
    DnsManagement: Perform DNS management for a domain
      Fields:
        domainId                   id<Domain>  immutable
            Identifier of the domain associated with this task
        due                        datetime?  server-set
            Due date and time for the task
        onSuccessRenewCertificate  boolean  mutable
            Whether to automatically renew the domain's TLS certificate using ACME after successfully updating DNS records
        status                     object<TaskStatus>  mutable
            Current status of the task
        updateRecords              set<enum (see DnsRecordType)>  mutable
            Which DNS records should be updated for the domain as part of this task

Filters:
    @type   enum (see TaskType)        Task type
    status  enum (see TaskStatusType)  Status
    due     date                       Due
